checked_by: automated render-pixel QA + image-capable qualitative review

qualitative_visual_review.method: image-capable manual inspection of exact rendered PNGs

slides.hierarchy: title followed by commitment/current-work regions
slides.qualitative_note: Readable NS101 and NS201 rows; no clipping, with deliberate whitespace below the progress view.

slides.hierarchy: title then hypothesis, falsifier, and question
slides.qualitative_note: The three H001 statements are readable and the bilingual question is not clipped.

slides.hierarchy: title then finding, conflict, and question
slides.qualitative_note: All three physical problem slots are visible and horizontally separated.

slides.hierarchy: title/focus followed by highlighted branch
slides.qualitative_note: The red hydration branch is distinct from the gray hierarchy and stays within canvas bounds.

slides.hierarchy: question and observation text beside visual
slides.qualitative_note: The scientific question and explicitly synthetic visual region are legible side by side.

slides.hierarchy: title then left synthesis and right strategy
slides.qualitative_note: Both structured regions remain readable; the sparse lower field reflects synthetic fixture density.

slides.hierarchy: matrix left and decision rule right
slides.qualitative_note: Variables, controls, replicates, metric, prediction, and rule are readable without clipping.

slides.hierarchy: matrix left and decision rule right
slides.qualitative_note: The second matrix is visually identifiable by EXP102 and its CV decision rule.

slides.hierarchy: title/control slot then chart
slides.qualitative_note: Axes, bars, and error bars are readable; the left control slot is physically present.

slides.hierarchy: title/control slot then chart
slides.qualitative_note: The exact PNG is nonblank and legible; this is the deliberate second result binding to the synthetic plot.

slides.hierarchy: title then result labels and integrated uncertainty
slides.qualitative_note: Supporting, contradicting, and uncertainty areas are visible without overlap or edge clipping.

slides.hierarchy: title then decision, uncertainty, next step
slides.qualitative_note: Each decision region is readable and horizontally ordered; multiline decision text stays inside its slot.

slides.hierarchy: title then transition nodes and derivation
slides.qualitative_note: The predecessor, results, precursor observation, successor, and derivation statement are readable.

slides.hierarchy: title then hypothesis, falsifier, and question
slides.qualitative_note: H002 statement, falsifier, and bilingual research question are legible with no clipped title.

slides.hierarchy: title then prior result, mechanism gap, question
slides.qualitative_note: All three H002 problem regions are visible and separated across the slide.

slides.hierarchy: title/focus followed by highlighted contact branch
slides.qualitative_note: The red contact branch is prominent against the gray hierarchy and distinct from H001 focus.

slides.hierarchy: title, question, observation, visual label
slides.qualitative_note: The question and observation content are readable; the right region truthfully names the registered synthetic visual.

slides.hierarchy: title/control label then CV and resistance panels
slides.qualitative_note: Both panels are readable and balanced, with an explicit synthetic-data title and axes.

slides.hierarchy: title then status, uncertainty, and next step
slides.qualitative_note: Supported status, uncertainty, and NS201 are readable and spatially separated without clipping.
